entry.title: New: Resolution 325 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PURCHASE WREATHS FOR THE WEST HAWAI‘I VETERANS CEMETERY-PU‘U HO‘OMAHA O NA PO‘E KOA O HAWAI‘I KOMOHANA FOR THE NATIONAL WREATHS ACROSS AMERICA DAY

Transfers $1,250 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 9)
